sections.label: Rocky footing and dragon coil
sections.evidence: Dark-gray y=0–2 bricks establish the central and right ground footprint. Green bricks at x=16–22 and y=2–6 curve around the tower's right and rear sides.

sections.label: Tower footing and surrounding coil
sections.evidence: Dark-gray bricks extend the footing toward smaller x coordinates and the rear. Central white walls rise from y=2, while green bricks fill the neighboring curve and begin the neck.

sections.label: Lighthouse entrance and striped shaft
sections.evidence: Brown #105, #161 and #205 stack at z=8–10. White walls rise through y=12, interrupted by the red y=8 band; low green additions complete the adjacent coil.

sections.label: Lighthouse window and lantern
sections.evidence: Blue #332 and #352 mark the shaft window. Dark-gray y=13 bricks spread beneath yellow lantern walls and gray corner pieces at y=14–16.

sections.label: Dragon coil and rising neck
sections.evidence: Green additions fill the low wrap and the rising mass at x=2–10, y=6–8. Higher green bricks project toward z=3–13 at y=13–14; tan #263 and #281 line the neck.

sections.label: Dragon head and wings
sections.evidence: Green bricks complete the neck and head through y=16. Orange bricks spread from x=0–8 across z=12–23 at y=8–14, forming wing surfaces behind the neck.

sections.label: Outer coil and tail
sections.evidence: Green bricks at x=20–22 and y=2–5 fill the outer curve. Green #140, #190 and #192 taper along z=18–20 beside the rear of the tower.

sections.label: Dragon horns
sections.evidence: Tan #461/#475 and #462/#476 form matching two-course projections at y=16–17 on opposite sides of the green head.

sections.label: Lighthouse roof and dragon face
sections.evidence: Red y=17 pieces and #486 at y=18 form the roof and tip. Black #438 and #441 mark paired eyes; green #377 fills the neck edge, with two low tail additions.

sections.label: Rocky rim and lighthouse crown
sections.evidence: Dark-gray pieces extend the low ground rim and y=13 lantern platform. Red #474, #481, #483, #472, #479, #484 and #485 fill the roof perimeter at y=17.
